name: Diamondhead
abilities: Body shapeshifting into blades, bludgeons, shields, swords
weaknesses: Sonic vibrations (Loboan howls, Ultimate Echo Echo discs) can shatter or knock him out
Cannot regenerate if his body is completely disassembled
Back shards can leave him stuck in walls
Can be trapped in crystal (Petropia Back-up Crystal)
summary: A living-crystal Petrosapien who grows and hurls diamond-hard crystal, reshapes his limbs into blades and refracts energy beams; one of Ben's toughest all-rounders.
traits: AF/UA version was bonded with Chromastone's Crystalsapien DNA
Restored the planet Petropia (The Secret of Chromastone)
Sharp crystal head and back shards
notableFeats: Beat Vilgax's giant Mechadroid on his first use (And Then There Were 10)
Defeated Vilgax after Chromastone's destruction (Vengeance of Vilgax: Part 2)
Restored Petropia with the Back-up Crystal (The Secret of Chromastone)
Survived being punched from Galvan Prime to Galvan B by Malgax (Malgax Attacks)
Fought Rex and deflected Caesar's Null Void projector (Heroes United)

appearances.designNotes: Yellow eyes; sleeveless uniform black on the right and white on the left, black shoulder patch with the original Omnitrix; four back shards. Ben 10,000's version wears a black shirt, white pants and the Omnitrix on his chest. Race Against Time (alt timeline) version is semi-translucent.

Chromastone-like indigo rock on lower body, torso and head crown, six back shards plus two chest shards, green eyes, Omnitrix on chest (shared AF/UA 'UAF' design). Bonded with Crystalsapien DNA in this era.
Same UAF design as Alien Force (indigo rock, chest shards, green eyes, Ultimatrix on chest). Heroes United adds forearm blades in Generator Rex's style.

16-year-old: all-black sleeveless suit with a green centre stripe, black pants, green/white Omnitrix belt, only two long back shards, no chest crystals, larger jaw. 11-year-old: OS-style half black/half white suit, green eyes and green Omnitrix.

scoring.rationale: Diamond-hard body shrugs off Vilgax, Sunder's axe and a Galvan-Prime-to-Galvan-B punch, refracts lasers, and his crystal generation is a flexible offense/defense toolkit. Slow and grounded, and sonic vibrations can shatter him outright.

notes: Wiki AF 'Season 2' = spec's AF Season 3 (Vengeance of Vilgax onward), so AF usedBy is ben-16-af.
Also used by Kevin (Framed), Gwen Prime (Inspector 13, UA), Albedo (The Final Battle: Part 1), Bioids, Gwen 10 and Mad Ben (OV) - not counted.
Ben 10,000 Returns: Ultimate Ben used Diamondhead's powers without transforming - not counted.
Editorial score calibration (principal pass): regeneration 6→4, survivability 8→6, defense 8→7 — to keep the roster ladder consistent across research batches.
